description: This file contains unit tests for the Thunder core timer functionalities, including looped timers, queued timers, past time scheduling, and watchdog timers, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: TimeHandler
classes.description: A handler class for timing events, managing a counter and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: WatchDogHandler
classes.description: A watchdog timer class derived from Thunder core's WatchDogType, managing timer start and expiration.

methods.name: TimeHandler::Timed
methods.description: Simulates a timed event, increments a counter, and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: TimeHandler::GetCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of timed events, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: WatchDogHandler::Start
methods.description: Starts the watchdog timer with a specified delay.

methods.name: WatchDogHandler::Expired
methods.description: Handles expiration of the watchdog timer, setting an event.

methods.name: WatchDogHandler::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the watchdog event to be set, with a timeout.
